Does GrPA have any weightage or bonus marks in the total score? Here in grading policy there is no mention about GrPA. Or the GrPA marks also will be taken for average in GAA ? Kindly clarify @21f3000759

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: GrPA marks will be considered for average in GAA. GAA marks includes GA + GrPAs.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
This is even more important to understand given week 10 scores are about to come out.

Please do not post you got only 50 marks instead of 100 in W10 GAA if you have not done W10 GrPA 1. You need to do both GA and GrPA to get 100 in GAA.
